metadata.name: No More Crash Builds
metadata.description:
No More Crash Builds
Your broken build shouldn't break the game.
Haemolacria + Parasite, Cricket's Body + Brimstone, Trisagion with tear splitters, Dr. Fetus + Scatter/Sad Bombs... the runs you dream about are the ones that freeze or crash the game. This mod keeps them alive WITHOUT nerfing them.
Always on, from the first room. Below the limits it does nothing at all. When the room gets crowded:
- Too many tears: pure visual effects (tear splash, blood particles, impact poofs) are skipped. Creep is never touched, it deals damage. Tears fired during the chaos stay quiet until they're gone, so the splash doesn't all come back at once and lag you right after the storm. - Way too many tears: new tears stop splitting, and the damage the split tears would have dealt goes into the parent tear. Same damage, a fraction of the entities. - Too many bombs: new bombs stop spawning more bombs. They still explode.
A tiny square at the top of the screen tells you what's going on: green = normal, yellow = skipping splash effects, red = merging split tears or stopping bomb chains. It goes back to green on its own. Can be turned off.
Mod Config Menu (optional): - Protection ON/OFF (turn it off and the other options hide) - Hide splash FX at: 25 to 150 tears (default 75) - Stop splitting at: 75 to 300 tears (default 150) - Stop bomb chains at: 6 to 24 bombs (default 12) - Status dot ON/OFF - Show counter (tears, bombs, lasers, effects on screen)
Lower = safer, higher = prettier. No REPENTOGON needed.
